name: Miletus
overview: Miletus, also known as Miletum, was a significant seaport in Asia Minor where the Apostle Paul stopped during his travels. From Miletus, Paul sent for the elders of the Ephesian church and solemnly addressed them, reminding them of his humble and faithful service among them, marked by teaching both publicly and from house to house. His message emphasized repentance toward God and faith in Jesus Christ, underscoring the centrality of the gospel in his ministry. Additionally, it is noted that Trophimus was left sick at Miletus during this time.
